metadata.scenario: A prospect inquires about the availability of gluten-free options on the catering menu. Category: General Information. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret, how can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Rose Patterson. I’m calling about my mother’s care. Hi, Rose! Always a pleasure to hear from you. How is your mother doing? She’s doing okay, but I have a quick question regarding her meals. Of course, what can I assist you with? I’ve been wondering if there are gluten-free options available for her meals? Great question! We do offer gluten-free meal options. That’s good to know. Can you tell me what those options include? Absolutely! Our gluten-free meals include options like grilled chicken with vegetables, gluten-free pasta, and salads. That sounds perfect. I just want to make sure she gets the right nutrition. I completely understand. Nutrition is essential, especially with her condition. Yes, and I want to ensure that her caregivers are aware of her dietary restrictions. I can definitely note that in her care plan. Would you like to discuss this with Lisa Chen, our Care Coordinator? Yes, I think that would be a good idea. Alright, I can set up a time for her to call you. Would tomorrow work for you? Yes, tomorrow would be great. Perfect! I’ll have Lisa reach out to you in the morning. Thank you! Also, is there a way to add meals to her existing schedule? Yes, we can add meals to her service plan. I can help you with that. What’s the cost for the gluten-free meal options? The gluten-free meals are included at no additional charge; they’re part of our meal service package. That’s fantastic! I appreciate you clarifying that. Not a problem at all, Rose. Your mother’s comfort is our priority. Thank you, Margaret. I feel better knowing we have these options. I’m glad to hear that! So just to recap, I’ll have Lisa call you tomorrow to discuss the meal plan. Yes, that sounds good. And if you need anything else in the meantime, feel free to reach out. Will do! Thank you so much for your help! You’re very welcome, Rose. Take care! You too, bye! Goodbye!
